item.title: Flash floods at Grand Canyon leave one dead and about 15 missing
item.description: The National Park Service reported violent flash floods in Bright Angel Canyon and Phantom Ranch, with over a dozen people unaccounted for.

item.title: Nepal-Tibet flood death toll exceeds 900 with thousands missing
item.description: Officials say at least 919 people have died from last week's flash flooding, with more than 4,700 still missing.

item.title: Dolly Parton's legacy extends beyond music to children's literacy
item.description: Her Imagination Library program provides books to young students, continuing her impact on education and reading.

item.title: U.S. launches military strikes on Iranian targets after month-long pause
item.description: With the conflict now past six months, neither side appears willing to de-escalate.
